strategy.summary: On Gridiron or Pro-Football, repeat the center spinner into the top lanes, use the upper flippers for controlled returns, and attack a vari-target only when a full hit and rebound are safe.

quickInfo.name: Center spinner
quickInfo.summary: The spinner advances yardage; Gridiron scores 1,000 per spin while Pro-Football scores one tenth as much.

quickInfo.name: Touchdown
quickInfo.summary: Both editions award a Touchdown at 100 yards, but only Pro-Football gives partial vari-target yardage.

quickInfo.name: Vari-target
quickInfo.summary: A deeper hit scores more points; Pro-Football adds up to 50 yards, while a full Gridiron hit awards a Touchdown.

quickInfo.name: Top lanes
quickInfo.summary: Pro-Football's best lanes add 50 yards and 500 points; Gridiron's lit lanes score 1,000, 3,000, or 5,000.

quickInfo.name: Paired flippers
quickInfo.summary: Each side has a lower scoring flipper and a steeper upper flipper for controlled top returns.

quickInfo.name: Edition scope
quickInfo.summary: Gridiron and Pro-Football share the layout but use different lane, spinner, and vari-target scoring.

steps.text: Press the right flipper to launch the ball. Watch the center return before you choose a shot.
Use a lower flipper to shoot through the center spinner. Favor a clean spinner pass over a partial vari-target hit.
Use the upper flippers to return the ball to the bumper and top-lane area.
modeNotes: Top play: The center and outside top lanes award the best listed yardage. Bumpers can move the ball between them.
Touchdown: Both editions award one after each 100 yards; Gridiron does not award partial yardage from its vari-targets.

steps.text: Repeat the spinner and top return. Nudge only after you learn the outer return paths.
Test one vari-target only when the flipper can push it fully back and the rebound stays in play.
Use the vari-target route when its full hit is repeatable. Return to the spinner when the hit is shallow or uncontrolled.

fallback.title: Upper-flipper top return
fallback.when: Use this when the spinner gap is unreliable or a spinner miss reaches the outlanes.

steps.text: Use either upper flipper to send the ball into the bumper area.
Guide the ball toward a 50-yard top lane when the movement is safe.
Collect yardage until the next Touchdown.
Return to the center spinner after the lower-flipper feed becomes controlled.

alternatives.title: Deep vari-target route
alternatives.when: Use this when a strong flipper makes a full target hit and the rebound is safe.

steps.text: Let the ball roll down the flipper face to add speed to the shot.
Push the vari-target as deep as possible.
Take the points and yardage. Stop after any center or outlane rebound.
Use the spinner and top lanes to add yardage.
Reach 100 yards to score a Touchdown.
Repeat the safe yardage route for each later Touchdown.

techniques.name: Lower-flipper spinner shot
techniques.instruction: Use a lower flipper for the flatter angle through the center spinner.

techniques.name: Rolling vari-target shot
techniques.instruction: Let the ball move down the flipper face before the flip. Use the added speed only after you know the rebound.

cautions.issue: A weak launch can return through the center before it reaches useful switches.
cautions.response: Keep both lower flippers ready when you press the launch flipper. Do not look away from the center feed.

cautions.issue: Vari-target rebounds and the outside vari-target chutes can send the ball to an outlane or the center drain.
cautions.response: Test one target hit. Use the spinner and top route when the rebound is not controlled.

cautions.issue: The upper and lower flippers have different shot angles.
cautions.response: Learn each pair before you commit to a narrow target. Use lower flippers for the spinner and upper flippers for top returns.

checkBeforePlay: Identify 1973 Pro-Football or 1977 Gridiron; spinner, lane, and vari-target yardage values differ substantially.
Test the right-button autolaunch, all four flippers, spinner strength, vari-target depth, top-lane lamps, and both outer return paths.
Confirm ball count, tilt, Touchdown scoring, and whether side-drain Touchdowns or replay awards receive tournament value.
strategy.simpleOverview: Gridiron and Pro-Football use the center spinner and top lanes to advance yardage toward each 100-yard Touchdown. Repeat that safe route with the paired upper flippers, and shoot the vari-target only when a full hit and its rebound are controlled.
strategy.overview: Gridiron and Pro-Football share a spinner, top lanes, paired upper flippers, and a variable-depth target, but their point and yardage values differ. Use the spinner and controlled top returns as the base route to each 100-yard Touchdown. Add the vari-target only when its deepest hit is reliable, accounting for the installed edition before relying on its yardage or scoring.
